rule: From Day 67 every student must be inside his own dorm area during the Night slot. The wild is off limits after the Afternoon slot. Town trips need a sign-out at the main gate and end with the Evening slot. Staff and council proctors walk the campus in pairs with lanterns.
gm: Breaking curfew is always possible and always a risk: a stealth/Nerve check, and being caught means a formal warning, and a second time means probation. Some people can cover for Rowan (silas, saoirse, viktor know the unlit paths; hana or camille may look away once if their route is far enough). The thing that walks at night never gets caught.
